# Offline Persian speech assets

- `vosk.js`: Vosk Browser 0.0.8, Apache-2.0, bundled locally.
- `model.tar.gz`: official `vosk-model-small-fa-0.42` Persian model, repackaged in the gzipped-tar format required by Vosk Browser; Apache-2.0.
- Model source: https://alphacephei.com/vosk/models
- Browser engine source: https://github.com/ccoreilly/vosk-browser
- The model is downloaded once by the app and cached on-device. Speech recognition runs locally after the assets are available.
